headline: Norsk Hydro Q3 Core Earnings Rise 52% but Miss Target on Soft Cash Flow
summary: Norsk Hydro posted a 52% increase in adjusted third-quarter core operating earnings, though results missed consensus analyst projections due to weaker operational cash flow.
why: Norsk Hydro is one of Europe's largest aluminum and renewable energy producers, sensitive to global industrial demand and energy power pricing.

impacts.name: Norsk Hydro ASA
impacts.why: Operating earnings missed market estimates because of weak cash conversion.
